name: Hidaka Fuyuka
source:
Arisa's second daughter. She is a sassy, rebellious, foul-mouthed, and quick with her hands. She has high specs in both her studies and athletic abilities.

She is spoiled by her older sister as well as her father, and is known as a problem child at her school. 

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/kk/character.html#Chara03]Official website[/url]]
